name: {{PLUGIN_NAME}}
description: {{DISPLAY_NAME}}: a human-in-the-loop UI for the code Claude is working on — review it in a localhost web UI, stream your feedback back into the session in realtime, and gate Claude's edits until you respond.

args:
import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
config = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or pathlib.Path.home() / ".claude")
installs = json.loads((config / "plugins" / "installed_plugins.json").read_text())["plugins"].get("{{PLUGIN_NAME}}@{{PLUGIN_NAME}}")
if not installs:
    raise SystemExit("{{BINARY_NAME}}: the {{PLUGIN_NAME}}@{{PLUGIN_NAME}} plugin is not installed")
newest = max(installs, key=lambda entry: entry.get("lastUpdated") or entry.get("installedAt") or "")
binary = str(pathlib.Path(newest["installPath"]) / "bin" / "{{BINARY_NAME}}")
subprocess.run([binary, "--version"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
os.execv(binary, [binary, *sys.argv[1:]])
